finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the email content contains malicious characters that could be interpreted as shell commands.
finding.assumptions: The email content is attacker-controlled and could potentially contain malicious characters.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the size of the email content exceeds the allocated buffer size.
finding.assumptions: The buffer size is not checked against the size of the email content.
